rationale: Separate the noun sense of mutuality from the adjective-like use in 相互の.
Keep the general gloss specific to an organization's general assembly; plenary session is context-dependent.
Use a natural Ukrainian equivalent for flowering herbaceous plants and retain the separate 草と花 sense.
Remove the unsupported requirement that damage must be assessed or compensated; retain general harm/loss.
Include the use of yielding one's own standards or demands, as in 品質で妥協しない.
Do not soften 退去を求められた to a voluntary suggestion.
Translate 大筋 as the overall direction/main outline, not procedural provisions.
Include the literal large-mouth and boastful-speech senses already present in the Japanese definition.
Include a large object in the Japanese definition and remove the unsupported prediction of a future master.
Render 告発された as a report to competent authorities, not a formal prosecutorial charge.
Include the literal metal-forging sense already noted in the card.
Include the figurative flexibility/adaptability sense as well as physical elasticity.
